content: धर्मः [ध्रियते लोकोऽनेन, धरति लोकं वा धृ-मन्; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 1. 137</ls>] .²1 Religion; the customary observances of a caste, sect, <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Law, usage, practice, custom, ordinance, statute. .²3 Religious or moral merit, virtue, righteousness, good works (regarded as one of the four ends of human existence); अनेन धर्मः सविशेषमद्य मे त्रिवर्गसारः प्रतिभाति भाविनि <ls>Ku. 5. 38</ls>, and see त्रिवर्ग also; एक एव सुहृद्धर्मो निधनेऽप्यनुयाति यः <ls>H. 1. 63</ls>. .²4 Duty, prescribed course of conduct; षष्ठांशवृत्तेरपि धर्म एषः <ls>Ś. 5. 4</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 114</ls>. .²5 Right, justice, equity, impartiality. .²6 Piety, propriety, decorum. .²7 Morality, ethics .²8 Nature. disposition, character; उत्पत्स्यतेऽस्ति मम कोऽपि समानधर्मा <ls>Māl. 1. 6</ls>; प्राणि˚, जीव˚. .²9 An essential quality, peculiarity, characteristic property, (peculiar) attribute; वदन्ति वर्ण्यावर्ण्यानां धर्मैक्यं दीपकं बुधाः <ls>Chandr. 5. 45</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 304</ls>. .²10 Manner, resemblance, likeness. .²11 A sacrifice. .²12 Good company, associating with the virtuous .²13 Devotion, religious abstraction. .²14 Manner, mode. .²15 An {%Upaniṣad%} <ab>q. v.</ab> .²16 <ab>N.</ab> of Yudhiṣṭhira, the eldest Pāṇḍava. .²17 <ab>N.</ab> of Yama, the god of death. .²18 A bow. .²19 A drinker of {%Soma%} juice. .²20 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of the ninth lunar mansion. .²21 An {%Arhat%} of the Jainas. .²22 The soul. .²23 Mastery, great skill; दिव्यास्त्रगुणसंपन्नः परं धर्मं गतो युधि <ls>Rām. 3. 31. 15</ls>. .{@-र्मम्@} A virtuous deed.
